"''Send them in.|Dar Wac announces the arrival of Supi and the committee to Palpatine|quotestart=0|audio=DarWac-AOTC.flac|}} '''Dar Wac''' was a [[Rodian]] who served as [[aide]] to [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] in his [[Office of the Chancellor|office]] during the [[Republic Era|final]] [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. ==Biography== A [[Rodian]], Dar Wac served the [[Galactic Republic]], a [[Democracy|democratic]] union that governed much of [[the galaxy]] from its [[capital]] [[planet]] of [[Coruscant]].''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' Following his election during the [[Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo|Invasion of]] [[Naboo]]{{Film|I}} in [[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Wac served as one of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]'s [[aide]]s alongside others including [[Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda]] and [[Chief of Staff]] [[Sly Moore]]. [[File:KenobisReport-AOTC.png|left|thumb|250px|Dar Wac was present among several others in the Chancellor's office when Obi-Wan Kenobi discovered the Separatist Droid Army on Geonosis.]] During the [[Separatist Crisis]], a period of [[Politics|political]] turmoil between the Republic and its splinter state, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Chancellor Palpatine met with several members of the [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Council|Council]] in his [[Emperor's office|office]] to discuss the repercussions of the growing Separatism. During the meeting, the [[Loyalist Committee]], an advisory body of ten [[senator]]s who helped Palpatine search for a solution to the crisis, arrived to speak with the Chancellor. Moments before, [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], the representative for the [[Chommell sector]], had narrowly escaped an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination attempt]]. Her ship was bombed as it landed on Coruscant, leading to numerous deaths. Wac contacted Palpatine via [[hologram]] and infored him of their arrival. Palpatine instructed Wac to send them in, and Wac did so. In the wake of the meeting and the assassination attempt on Senator Amidala's life, [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] embarked on an investigation of the plot to kill her. As he tracked down bounty hunter [[Jango Fett]], who he suspected of being behind the assassination attempts, Kenobi [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)|inadvertently uncovered]] a [[Cloning|clone]] army created by the [[Kaminoan|cloners]] on [[Kamino]] for use by the Republic. After following Fett to [[Geonosis]], Kenobi also discovered that the Confederacy had [[Geonosian accord|forged a contract]] with several megacorporations to manufacture an [[Separatist Droid Army|army]] of [[battle droid]]s to wage war against the Republic and that the multitude of attempted assassinations on Amidala were orchestrated by Trade Federation [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]]. From his remote location, Kenobi contacted Senator Amidala and his [[Padawan]] learner, [[Anakin Skywalker]] on [[Tatooine]], who forwarded his message to Palpatine's office in turn, where Wac, alongside members of the Loyalist Committee and Jedi Order, were gathered to hear his findings. [[File:Palpatine on balcony.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Along with the Supreme Chancellor and his allies, Dar Wac saw the deployment of the Grand Army of the Republic on Coruscant.]] Not long after, the [[Junior Representative]] of Naboo, [[Jar Jar Binks]], proposed a motion to expand the [[Emergency Powers Act]], which would allow Chancellor Palpatine to remain in his office even after his term limit expired''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' and allow him to form a [[Grand Army of the Republic]] out of the [[Kaminoan]] clones. The measure passed, and the clone forces created on Kamino were officially commissioned as the Grand Army of the Republic. The new Republic army saw its first use soon after its formation at the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], where the Jedi led the army into battle in an attempt to destroy the droid armies and rescue Kenobi, who had been taken captive by the Confederacy, and Skywalker and Amidala, who had disobeyed orders and attempted to rescue Kenobi themselves. Though the trio of captives were successfully rescued by the Republic army, the Confederacy forces managed to evacuate, and the Republic failed to quash what would become known as the [[Clone Wars]] before it could spread. ==Equipment== Wac had [[Color|green]] skin and black [[eye]]s. They wore black [[boot]]s, baggy brown pants, a brown shirt, and a light brown [[Clothing|jacket]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:DarWacDesk-ArtOfRotS.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Concept art from Revenge of the Sith depicts a scene including Dar Wac confronting Mace Windu as he attempted to arrest Palpatine, but it was cut.]] Dar Wac first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of the film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] by [[R. A. Salvatore]],[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]] released on [[April 23]], [[2002]], and then in the film itself on [[May 16]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' Concept art''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]'' and the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|illustrated screenplay]] of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] depicts that a scene in which Wac and two members of the [[Senate Guard]] attempt to stop [[Mace Windu]] and his team of [[Jedi]] reaching Palpatine to [[Duel in Palpatine's office|arrest him]] before being [[Telekinesis|Force pushed]] into the walls by the Jedi was planned;[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']] however, it did not make it into the final film.{{Film|III}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|II}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|44|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' {{1stID|Dar Wac}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Chancellors, Senators and States Persons of the Republic}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Dar Wac |fr=Dar Wac |ja=ダー・ウォック }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Wac, Dar}} [[Category:Clerical workers and assistants]] [[Category:Galactic Republic bureaucrats]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Rodians]]
